info.title: Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Interface — Virtual & Overlay
info.description:
Virtual, overlay and switching interface configuration.

**Types covered (18):** Loopback, Tunnel, Virtual-Template, Virtual-PPP, VirtualPortGroup, vasileft, vasiright, Vif, Vlan, BDI, BD-VIF, LISP, LISP-subinterface, L2LISP, L2LISP-subinterface, nve, overlay, pseudowire

**Common use cases:** Loopback for router-ID/management, Tunnel for GRE/IPsec/DMVPN, Vlan SVIs, nve for VXLAN, LISP for SD-Access

**YANG:** Cisco-IOS-XE-native interface container + augments from tunnel, policy, etc.

get.description:
Retrieve all Loopback interface configurations.

CLI equivalent: `show running-config | section interface Loopback`

Returns a list of Loopback interfaces with their name (key), IP addressing, shutdown state, description, and augmented features (QoS service-policy, ACL bindings, etc.).

patch.description: Merge update to Loopback interface configurations.
